AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.subtitle: Who We Are
AboutUs.description: BlackHousse is a gourmet restaurant and fast-food dedicated to delivering an exceptional dining experience. We combine fresh ingredients, meticulous preparation and passion for great flavors to satisfy all your cravings, in-store or delivered to your door.
AboutUs.missionText: To serve generous, flavorful meals while providing a fast, modern and seamless digital ordering experience.
AboutUs.visionText: To become the benchmark for premium gourmet fast food in Algeria.

HelpCenter.title: Help Center & FAQ
HelpCenter.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
HelpCenter.description: Find quick answers to common questions about online orders, delivery, live tracking and our services.

faq.q: How do I place an order on BlackHousse?
faq.a: Head over to 'Our Menu' or click 'Order Now', select your favorite items, customize your options, and confirm your cart with your address and phone number.
You can choose between home delivery in your municipality or pickup (takeaway) at our restaurant counter.

faq.q: How can I track my order in real time?
faq.a: Once your order is confirmed, a unique reference code is assigned to you. You can track progress live via the 'Track order' button in the menu.

faq.q: Can I receive notifications on my order status?
faq.a: Yes, you can enable browser push notifications on your phone or computer to get notified as soon as your order is confirmed, in preparation, or out for delivery.
Payment is made in cash upon delivery at your door, or at the counter upon pickup.

faq.q: How do I contact customer support if there's an issue?
faq.a: You can reach us by phone at 0658953461, by email at BlackHousse@gmail.com, or via WhatsApp and Telegram linked in the footer.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: Your personal data is safe with us
PrivacyPolicy.description: At BlackHousse, we place the utmost importance on the privacy and security of your personal data.

sections.title: Data Collection
sections.text: We collect only the information required to process and fulfill your orders (name, phone number, delivery address and push notification settings).

sections.title: Data Usage
sections.text: Your data is used exclusively to prepare your meals, ensure swift delivery and provide you with real-time status updates.

sections.title: Security & Confidentiality
sections.text: We apply strict security standards. Your personal information is never sold, shared or transferred to third parties without your explicit consent.

TermsConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsConditions.subtitle: Please read carefully
TermsConditions.description: By using the BlackHousse ordering platform, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions outlined below governing our restaurant and delivery services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.text: Accessing and using our online services constitutes full and unconditional acceptance of these terms and conditions.

sections.title: 2. Orders and Availability
sections.text: Every order is sent directly to our kitchen. Dishes are subject to the availability of fresh ingredients and daily stock.

sections.title: 3. Delivery & Estimates
sections.text: We strive to deliver your meals hot and within estimated timeframes. Delivery times may vary depending on traffic and peak hours.

sections.title: 4. Payment
sections.text: Payment for orders is made in cash upon home delivery or upon pickup at the restaurant counter.

sections.title: 5. Cancellations & Claims
sections.text: If there is any issue with a delivered order, please contact our customer support immediately at 0658953461.

Pwa.modalSubtitle: 1-click instant access • Fullscreen mode • No heavy download
Pwa.iosTip: On iPhone and iPad, use Safari browser to add the app.
Pwa.iosStep1Desc: Located in the toolbar at the bottom of your Safari screen (or top on iPad).
Pwa.iosStep2Desc: Scroll down the share menu until you see this option.
Pwa.iosStep3Desc: The BlackHousse icon will appear immediately on your home screen as a native app.
Pwa.androidDesc: Installing on Android gives you a smooth fullscreen experience with real-time order notifications.
Pwa.androidStep1Desc: In Chrome, Samsung Internet or Edge, tap the 3 dots (⋮) in the top corner.
Pwa.androidStep2Desc: Or 'Add to Home screen' depending on your browser.
Pwa.androidStep3Desc: The app installs in seconds without going through the Play Store.
Pwa.androidManualHint: Tip: If the prompt doesn't open automatically, tap the 3 dots (⋮) in the top browser corner and select 'Install app'.
Pwa.macosDesc: On Mac, you can install BlackHousse directly into your Dock via Safari or Google Chrome.
Pwa.macosSafariDesc:
1. Click the File menu in Mac's top bar.
2. Select 'Add to Dock...'.
3. Click 'Add'.
Pwa.macosChromeTitle: Option B: With Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge
Pwa.macosChromeDesc:
1. Click the install icon in the right side of the address bar.
2. Click 'Install' in the confirmation popup.
Pwa.windowsDesc: On Windows 10/11, BlackHousse integrates as a desktop application in the Start menu and taskbar.
Pwa.windowsStep1Title: Locate the icon in the address bar
Pwa.windowsStep1Desc: In Chrome or Edge, a small install icon appears on the right of the URL bar.
Pwa.windowsStep2Desc: A standalone window will open without cluttered browser toolbars.
